reason: #939 made BrowserAutomationService.create_lease/revoke_run and RuntimePlatform.chat_components coroutines, but MissionService.start_mission, MissionService._revoke_browser_control and AutomationToolPlatform.mission_components kept calling them without await. Native browser-autonomy missions were queued with no browser lease (and a refused lease was accepted as 202), stopped/failed/finished missions never revoked their lease, and every native mission with an MCP server failed preflight with "'coroutine' object has no attribute 'specs'". The fix awaits all three and makes _revoke_browser_control async at its five callers. Selected: the new route-level regressions (browser lease created, lease refusal fails the run with 422, stop and failure revoke the lease and free the session, MCP mission starts with and without browser autonomy) plus the repaired browser-mission test; every test_missions case that passes on origin/main (start/stop/startup reconcile/recovery paths that now await revocation); the browser automation service suite; mission checkpoint retention cases that pass on main; and the browser and automation mission_components output-budget cases.
exclusions: No full suites. No frontend, native or Playwright changes; the fix is Core-only and was exercised through the same /api/v1/missions, /runs/{id}/stop and /runs/{id}/browser-automation endpoints the Workbench Browser, New Mission dialog and Butler use on a scratch supervisor Core (evidence in the PR body). The real-Core Playwright area butler-browser-mission asserts this lease but is not selected: it fails on origin/main by construction and was not run locally under the shared host load. Other cases in tests/v3/test_missions.py (9), test_automation_runtime.py (7), test_mission_checkpoint_retention.py (2), test_model_output_budget.py (9), test_control_assistant_work.py (36) and test_chat_subagents.py (22) fail identically on pristine origin/main (unawaited test-client and fixture calls left by the async conversion), so they cannot prove this change; the branch adds no new failures in any of those files.
